plan_id.description: Id for this plan submission (UUID recommended). Content identity is sha256( JCS-canonicalized plan JSON ) and is represented as `sha256:<hex>`.

actor.description: Selectors describing who requested the stop (optional; never embed secrets).

target.description: Where the microVM should be stopped.

expect_generation_digest.description: Optional guard: deny if the host is not running this generation digest.

instance.description: Stable instance identity (used for receipts and idempotency).

expect_running_plan_digest.description: Optional guard: if an instance is running under a different plan digest, deny (prevents accidental stops after a replacement/identity transition).

policy_digest.description: Digest of the policy module(s) authorizing this stop (local authority boundary).

requested.description: Caller-provided knobs. Policy may tighten, ignore, or deny.

mode.description: graceful: attempt in-guest shutdown if supported. force: terminate/destroy the backend instance (may risk data integrity).

timeout_ms.description: Bounded wait time for graceful shutdown attempts (policy may cap).
